title: Config: ExternalPinServiceConfig in transit PinningConfig
description:
What: Add external_services list to transit PinningConfig and validate HTTPS endpoints.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/transit/src/config.rs, add struct ExternalPinServiceConfig:
   pub name: String  -- human label for logs and admin API
   pub endpoint: String  -- base URL; MUST be https://
   pub api_key: String  -- Bearer token (never logged; see e0v.3)
   pub groups: Vec<String>  -- group glob patterns; empty = all groups
   pub connect_timeout_secs: u64  -- default 5
   pub request_timeout_secs: u64  -- default 20
   pub max_attempts: usize  -- default 3
2. Add #[serde(default)] pub external_services: Vec<ExternalPinServiceConfig> to PinningConfig
3. In Config::validate(), for each external service:
   - MUST have non-empty name
   - MUST have endpoint starting with 'https://' (return ConfigError::Validation if http:// or other scheme)
   - MUST have non-empty api_key
   - connect_timeout_secs must be >= 1
   - request_timeout_secs must be >= 1
4. Implement Default for ExternalPinServiceConfig defaults (connect 5, request 20, max_attempts 3)
5. Derive Debug on ExternalPinServiceConfig — api_key will be visible in Debug output for now (e0v.3 adds redaction)

Defensive programming:
- Fail-closed: reject http:// endpoints at config validation time, not at runtime
- Empty external_services is valid (external pinning is optional)
- name must be unique across services (validate in Config::validate())
